title: John Paul and Lily go on telepathic dates from different floors

tellings.quote: well often they'll be on different floors of the house and but they're communicating

plain: Two young people named John Paul and Lily go on "dates" by mind alone, often sitting on different floors of the same house in Atlanta while, it is said, they communicate. The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made a documentary about children said to read minds, tells Michels this as something she heard from a woman named Libby around 2023; if true, it would be telepathy between two people who cannot see each other.
